disease_label_per_paper: Serotonin syndrome with concomitant venlafaxine and tramadol after venlafaxine dose increase
presentation_summary: 58-year-old woman with major depressive disorder and neuropathic pain was taking venlafaxine 75 mg daily and tramadol 50 mg twice daily.
Venlafaxine was increased from 75 mg to 150 mg daily.
The next day she developed tremor, clonus, diaphoresis, and diarrhea.
Exam showed agitation, generalized tremor, hyperreflexia, inducible clonus, tachycardia 115/min, blood pressure 158/94 mmHg, and fever 38 C.
Venlafaxine and tramadol were stopped and diazepam 10 mg was prescribed; symptoms resolved by the next-day follow-up.
